en.title: Taiwan raises international fuel surcharges from November 8 as oil prices climb
en.summary: Taiwan's Civil Aviation Administration said national carriers' international passenger fuel surcharges will rise from November 8 to US$40 for short-haul routes and US$104 for long-haul routes, after the benchmark fuel price moved up a tier.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aviation Administration announced on November 2 that national carriers' international passenger fuel surcharges will increase from November 8: short-haul routes will rise from US$37.5 to US$40, and long-haul routes from US$97.5 to US$104. The increase follows a rise in the benchmark international aviation fuel price announced by CPC, from US$177.89 per barrel to US$183.09 per barrel, moving the surcharge from tier 15 to tier 16.

Under the mechanism coordinated by the administration with national carriers in 2005, the benchmark price determines the tier: below US$40 per barrel there is no charge, while the US$40 to under US$50 tier charges US$5 for short-haul and US$13 for long-haul, and each further US$10 rise adds US$2.5 for short-haul and US$6.5 for long-haul. Short-haul covers Asia excluding India and the Middle East, while long-haul covers Europe, the Americas, Africa, Oceania, Antarctica, India and the Middle East.

The administration said it has required carriers to fully disclose relevant information to protect consumer rights, and asked airlines to disclose background information in an appropriate way, such as the proportion of fuel cost in total cost or the calculation method. Passengers may contact airlines or check their official websites for details.

zh.title: 臺灣國籍航空國際線燃油附加費11月8日起調漲短程40美元長程104美元
zh.summary: 交通部民用航空局11月2日宣布，國籍航空公司國際線客運燃油附加費自11月8日起調漲，短程航線調漲為40美元，長程航線調漲為104美元。
body: 交通部民用航空局11月2日宣布，由於航空燃油價格近期上漲，國籍航空公司國際線客運燃油附加費自11月8日起調漲，短程航線由37.5美元調漲為40美元，長程航線由97.5美元調漲為104美元。此次調整依據中油公司公告的國際航空燃油牌價，由每桶177.89美元上漲至183.09美元，級距由第15級升至第16級。
依民航局2005年與國籍航空公司協調的機制，牌價決定級距：未達每桶40美元不收費，40美元至未滿50美元的級距短程收費5美元、長程收費13美元，油價每再增加10美元，短程增加2.5美元、長程增加6.5美元。短程為亞洲地區（印度與中東除外），長程為歐洲、美洲、非洲、大洋洲、南極洲、印度與中東地區。
民航局表示，已要求業者充分揭露相關資訊以維護消費者權益，並請航空公司以適當方式揭露背景資訊，例如燃油成本占總成本的比例或計算方式。旅客可洽詢航空公司或查詢其官方網站。
